package rulefixtures

// scenario for allocation_churn_in_loop: Obvious make, new, or buffer-construction calls inside loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.

func scenario437Positive(items []string) []string {
	var out []string
	for _, item := range items {
		buf := make([]byte, 0, 256)
		buf = append(buf, item...)
		out = append(out, string(buf))
	}
	return out
}
